full.description: This is a dental X-ray image showing the upper jaw and teeth. A well-defined, complex radiopacity resembling multiple rudimentary tooth structures is visible within the bone. This appearance is characteristic of a compound odontoma, a type of benign odontogenic tumor. The lesion is located between the roots of adjacent erupted teeth, causing some displacement.

random.description: This is a dental X-ray image showing the maxillary arch and surrounding bone structures. The radiograph reveals an impacted, malformed tooth or odontogenic anomaly located within the alveolar bone between adjacent dental roots. The unusual structure exhibits mixed radiodensity resembling tooth-like elements. These findings are characteristic of a complex odontoma or a supernumerary tooth.
